study type: Prospective, single-arm, open-label Phase II clinical trial
exposure: Sustained weekly administration of 2 mg/kg ILB(r) (a low-molecular weight dextran sulphate)
cohort: Patients aged at least 18 years with a definite diagnosis of Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) according to El Escorial Criteria.
finding: Long-term weekly ILB(r) injections of 2 mg/kg were well tolerated and had an acceptable safety profile in patients with ALS.
followup_time: Up to 38 weeks for treatment, with long-term follow-up observations of mortality reported between 53 and 62 weeks after final injection.
